channel.title: The New Arab - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The New Arab (newarab.com)

item.title: US-Israel war on Iran ’breach of international law’: Steinmeier
item.description: German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier has warned of a “deep rift” with the US, calling the US-Israeli war on Iran a breach of international law.

item.title: Sudan hospital attack toll rises to 70: WHO
item.description: The death toll from a hospital strike in East Darfur has risen to 70, the WHO said, condemning the attack as devastating for civilians in Sudan’s war.

item.title: Al Jazeera crew ’harassed’ while covering arson attack in London
item.description: Videos show the journalists being confronted by a group of men and onlookers chanting ’Al Jazeera off our streets’, accusing journalists of being antisemitic.

item.title: Iranian ballistic missiles kill six Peshmerga in Iraq’s Erbil
item.description: Iranian missile strikes on a Peshmerga base in Erbil province killed six and wounded dozens, escalating regional tensions and raising fears of further violence.

item.title: Afghanistan announces release of detained US citizen
item.description: The Afghan Taliban government said on Tuesday that it has decided to release U.S. detainee Dennis Coyle in response to a request from his mother.

item.title: Can Lebanon Survive the Digital War?
item.description: From surveillance tech to online disinformation, responding to Israel’s digital assault on Lebanon is essential, writes Mohamad Najem.

item.title: North Korea head uses US ’aggression’ to justify nuclear arsenal
item.description: North Korea has been a fierce critic of US and Israeli aggression in the region, with its leader Kim Jong Un now speaking against the Iran war.

item.title: Asia faces energy shock as Hormuz closure disrupts oil, gas flow
item.description: Asia faces fuel shortages and rising costs as the Hormuz closure disrupts vital oil and gas supplies.

item.title: Israel prepares to mobilise 400,000 reservists in Lebanon war
item.description: Israel prepares to mobilise 400,000 reservists as it escalates its war on Lebanon, with deadly strikes intensifying despite limited ground advances

item.title: Why is Pakistan being touted as mediator between US and Iran?
item.description: Pakistan is pushing itself as mediator between Iran and the US should either party agree to talks aimed at solving the conflict.
